description: Define a product's variants. Each variant is one combination of values for the model's variantAxes (set those with update_model) and carries its own price, stock, SKU and volume breaks. The call replaces the whole set, so send every variant the product keeps - a variant left out is deleted. Every field but tiers and currencyPrices is written as sent (those two are kept when omitted), so copy sku and stock (onHand) from list_products for each variant you keep; both are required, null for none. Stock already reserved by carts stays with the variant that keeps its selection. Prices are minor units: price and tiers in the default currency, currencyPrices in each additional currency (omitted = kept, like tiers). To change only prices per currency use set_product_currency_prices variants instead - it never touches stock or SKU.

variants.description: The product's whole variant set, at most 500. It replaces what is stored; [] removes every variant.

currencyPrices.description: The variant's prices in additional currencies, e.g. [{currency: 'EUR', price: 4500}]. Omit to keep the ones it has; [] clears them. A variant with no price in a channel's currency is not sold on that channel

currency.description: One of the workspace's additional currencies

price.description: The variant's price in minor units of that currency

tiers.description: The variant's own breaks in that currency; omitted or [] = the product's breaks in that currency (set_product_currency_prices)

minQty.description: Quantity at which this price starts applying (>= 2)

price.description: Unit price at this quantity, minor units (4900 = $49.00) - tiers are stored in minor units, unlike the base price field (major units)

inventory.description: Units on hand - list_products reports it as onHand. null when the variant's stock is not tracked.

price.description: Minor units of the default currency - 4900 = $49.00. Unlike the product's price field, which is major units.

selections.description: One value for each of the model's variantAxes and nothing else, e.g. {size: 'M', color: 'red'}. Each value must be one of that select field's options. No two variants may share a selection.

sku.description: Unique across the model, and different from the product's own SKU. null when the variant has none.

tiers.description: This variant's own volume breaks, minor units of the default currency. Omit to keep the breaks it has. [] drops them, and the variant is then priced by the record's breaks (set_product_tiers), not by none.

minQty.description: Quantity at which this price starts applying (>= 2)

price.description: Unit price at this quantity, minor units (4900 = $49.00) - tiers are stored in minor units, unlike the base price field (major units)

name: set_product_variants
title: Set product variants
